description: Self-hosted surveys and feedback: the management API in all three current generations (v1 surveys, responses, contacts, action classes and webhooks; v2 responses, contacts, webhooks, teams and users; v3 surveys, workflows, tags and feedback records) plus the public client API. Publishing, webhooks, response writes and membership changes are held for approval.
